theorems.name: Submission.emf_exists_cone_filling
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsCompact S.support → S.boundary = 0 → ∃ R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 2), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsCompact R.support ∧ R.boundary = S
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
